title: Decomposition of a bit string containing zero
statement: Let $w$ be a bit string containing at least one $0$. Apply the first transducer, started in its specified initial state, to obtain an output string $H$, and apply the second transducer, also from its specified initial state, to obtain an output string $R$. Then $w$ is a string of $|H|$ consecutive $1$s followed by $0$ and then $R$.
